_note: Name-facts for Malawi (FT-72, docs/PLAN_V0.12.md). See italy.json for the rules.
Begun with the towns on the continent maps, each as a "city" entry so that a region
of the same id, written later, never shows a town's sentences.

en: The capital since 1975, planned as a garden city.
It took over from Zomba, the old colonial capital.
It lies near the middle of the country, on the Lilongwe river.
it: La capitale dal 1975, progettata come città giardino.
Prese il posto di Zomba, la vecchia capitale coloniale.
Si trova vicino al centro del paese, sul fiume Lilongwe.
de: Die Hauptstadt seit 1975, als Gartenstadt geplant.
Sie löste Zomba ab, die alte Kolonialhauptstadt.
Sie liegt nahe der Mitte des Landes, am Fluss Lilongwe.

en: Named after the Scottish town where David Livingstone was born.
It was founded as a Church of Scotland mission in 1876.
It merged with the neighbouring railway town of Limbe in 1956.
it: Prende il nome dalla città scozzese dove nacque David Livingstone.
Fu fondata nel 1876 come missione della Chiesa di Scozia.
Nel 1956 si unì alla vicina città ferroviaria di Limbe.
de: Nach der schottischen Stadt benannt, in der David Livingstone geboren wurde.
Sie wurde 1876 als Mission der Church of Scotland gegründet.
Sie vereinigte sich 1956 mit der benachbarten Eisenbahnstadt Limbe.
